name: Rocket engineering, not rocket science
definition: We are a product company that builds what customers love. A scientific method is an invaluable tool to design better things, but the science itself is rarely the point. We keep the product and the customer in mind.

rows.under: Wanting to do a deep dive into every detail of what we are doing, even if that aspect of the design is not very impactful on the overall performance.
rows.justRight: We have a healthy respect for difficult problems but are selective about which ones we delve deep into and solve at the root. We often make do with a lack of understanding when faced with short-term challenges we know we will solve in the long term in some other way.
rows.over: Avoiding the fundamental understanding needed to conquer an issue that is core to our IP. Trying to solve the problem through brute force trial and error.
